answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 44153 Country: India Title: about quran shareef falling on ground Question: What should we do if QURAN SHAREEF falls down by mistake? Answer ID: 44153 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 414/394/N=1434) If the Quran fell due to intentional acts, then you should do taubah and istighfar. You should also determine to avoid indifference towards the Quran again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
